auditor.independence_basis: The merge composed two independently audited snapshots; this run translated no value. It is a distinct session from both translators (`i18n-translator` on each side) and from the auditors whose rows are recorded in `superseded`.

scope: Merge composition of `feat/i18n-canvas-batch` (fc42fca230) with origin/main (1320319c9a) for the seven shipped locales of `ui.common.updates`. Verifies that the union keeps every key, that every merged value is byte-identical to its value in one of the two audited snapshots, and that the combined key sets/placeholders are intact. No retranslation, no rendered UI frame pass, and no native-speaker sign-off are claimed.
method: Built each merged catalogue as the key union of the two branch tips: 40 keys added across the merge (31 from origin/main's update-failure vocabulary, 9 from the canvas batch) over 127 shared keys.
Compared overlapping keys: 0 differed between the two tips in all seven locales, so the union has one unambiguous value per key.
Proved per-key provenance: every merged value equals the same key's value in the audited `ours` or `theirs` snapshot; no value was edited in this merge.
Ran the catalogue gates at the merged tree: generator freshness, check-strings, context parity, locale-parity 43/43 (key sets, ICU placeholders, non-English stubs) and the coverage gate.

Read the 40 added English keys and their translations in all seven locales; spot-read the full update-failure group (cause, consequence, remedy, step) in es, ru, zh-CN and the long rebuild sentence in every locale.
